name: BotDesk Mobility Gateway
description: Platform-neutral Web2.5 M2M routing gateway for autonomous Robotaxi rides and Rental passenger fleets, backed by verified ENS endpoints.

extensions.description: On-chain ENS endpoint routing and certified settlement token verification

skills.name: Step 1: Discovery & Market Scan
skills.description: Scans available Robotaxi fleets and Rental depots across airports and hubs.
examples: Find an autonomous robotaxi from Schiphol Airport to Amsterdam Zuid
Search available electric rental cars at Amsterdam Airport

skills.name: Step 2: Real-Time Binding Quotation
skills.description: Fetches binding dynamic rates and vehicle specifications via on-chain oracles.
examples: Get a binding fare quote for a 15km robotaxi trip
Calculate a 4-day rental rate including insurance

skills.name: Step 3: Identity, DID & ZKP Compliance
skills.description: Validates digital driver licenses (ZKP), operator trust scores, and agent spending allowances.
examples: Verify passenger driver license ZKP for autonomous car rental
Check agent allowance consent before booking

skills.name: Step 4: Booking & Transaction Lock
skills.description: Locks vehicles and validates the certified settlement_token issued by the proprietary settlement module.
examples: Lock robotaxi vehicle with certified settlement token
Confirm rental reservation via certified settlement handshake

skills.name: Step 5: Pickup, Access & Vehicle Control
skills.description: Provides live GPS approach telemetry, digital inspection logs, and cryptographic door unlock.
examples: Unlock assigned robotaxi at pickup coordinates
Submit pre-rental battery and damage inspection

skills.name: Step 6: Return, Completion & Invoicing
skills.description: Concludes trips, calculates local city/tourist taxes, and triggers final invoice generation via the proprietary module.
examples: Conclude robotaxi trip and trigger invoice settlement
Complete rental return and generate final VAT invoice

skills.name: Step 7: Calamities & Post-Trip Resolution
skills.description: Handles trip extensions, cancellations, and automated accident/damage telemetry snapshots.
examples: Extend active car rental duration by 24 hours
Submit telemetry snapshot for a rental damage claim
